decision_conditions: 'Demolition of existing buildings (with retention of a single dwelling) and redevelopment of the site to provide up to 116 residential units and 175 sqm commercial floorspace (Use Class E(g)) with associated hard and soft landscaping, car parking and highways works and other associated works. [Non-material amendment to planning permission 22/2556/FUL to vary the wording of condition U0179132 (Traffic Management) to to align the condition with the approved Construction Management Scheme (CMS) (Condition U0179001) which outlines the construction of the development is phased, which means that only anti-clockwise travel will not be possible by the time of the first occupations on site.]'
